title: e-Invoices
forbidden: The e-invoice screens open only in the brand center with e-invoice read access.
module_off: These screens work while the e-invoice (UBL-TR) add-on is on. You can request it on the Features page.
list.description: E-invoices (UBL-TR) the center issues to distributors and dealers. Nothing is sent: invoices are validated, numbered and archived.
list.empty_description: Create drafts from the Billable records tab.
billable.title: Billable records
billable.description: Received distributor orders and posted service catalog periods without an active invoice.
billable.missing_fields: The buyer's invoice profile is missing: {{fields}}
billable.empty_description: Received orders and posted periods are listed here.
detail.title: e-Invoice
detail.preview_error: The preview could not be opened
archive.confirm_description: Nothing is sent, the invoice is only archived. The XML is validated (XSD + Schematron); when valid it takes the next number of its series and the XML and PDF are stored in the archive.
archive.failed: Validation failed; no number was used. Review the messages.
archive.invalid_hint: Validation is invalid: this invoice cannot be archived. Fix the source or the buyer profile, void the invoice and draft it again.
void.title: Void the e-invoice?
void.description: {{number}} is only marked voided; the number and files are kept and the source can be invoiced again. Nothing is sent anywhere.
void.reason_hint: A reason is required (at most 1000 characters).
pdf.pending: The PDF is not ready yet
pdf.retry_queued: The PDF was queued to render again
settings.title: E-invoice settings
settings.description: Seller details, series, counters and the invoice look (XSLT).
settings.series_hint: Each series is exactly 3 characters (A-Z, 0-9). Number format: SERIES + YEAR + 9 digits, e.g. EAR2026000000001.
settings.earchive_series_hint: e-Archive invoices (buyers not registered for e-Fatura)
settings.pdf_enabled_hint: The PDF of an archived invoice is rendered automatically.
settings.read_only: Only authorized administrators can change the settings.
settings.not_configured: The settings are not saved yet; drafts and archiving stay closed until then.
settings.xslt_hint: By default the general XSLT template of GİB (Turkish Revenue Administration) is used. You can upload your own (at most 1 MB, root element xsl:stylesheet); it is tried on a sample invoice first.
settings.xslt_reset_description: The custom XSLT is removed and the general GİB template is used. PDFs of archived invoices do not change; render a PDF again if needed.
settings.xslt_too_large: The file cannot be larger than 1 MB.
settings.validation.mersis: The MERSİS no. must have 16 digits.
settings.validation.series_length: The series must be exactly 3 characters.
settings.validation.series_chars: The series may contain only A-Z and 0-9.
settings.validation.series_reserved: The TMP series is reserved for drafts.
profile.title: Invoice profile
profile.id_hint: Enter either the VKN or the TCKN, not both.
profile.registered_hint: A buyer registered for e-Fatura gets TICARIFATURA from the e-Fatura series; others get e-Archive.
profile.validation.one_id: Enter either the VKN or the TCKN, not both.
